programmes.title: Individual & Performance Coaching
programmes.intro: Focused coaching for players who want to put extra time into their game. Develop your skills, build confidence and work towards your goals with support that fits your stage of development.
programmes.audience: Players looking for individual attention or small-group development alongside their school or club sport.

features.title: Personal attention
features.text: Football 1:1 sessions focus on your individual skills and understanding of the game.

features.title: Purposeful practice
features.text: Work on technical skills and game-specific challenges, with feedback to help you keep improving.

features.title: Small-group development
features.text: Train with other motivated players in a supportive coaching environment. Enquire about the right option for your sport.

programmes.title: Proteus Academy
programmes.intro: For ambitious young football and basketball players who are ready to work hard, learn and keep developing. A structured programme that supports your journey alongside your existing school and club environment.
programmes.audience: Young football and basketball athletes with the ambition to develop and the commitment to put in the work.

features.title: Develop the whole athlete
features.text: A programme bringing together technical development, athletic performance, performance psychology and athlete education.

features.title: A plan for your progress
features.text: Small-group development, individual planning and regular feedback help you understand what to work on next.

features.title: Support along the way
features.text: Coaching and ongoing guidance that work alongside your school and club commitments.

programmes.enquiryGuidance: Tell us your name and age, sport, school, and current team or club. Our team will be in touch to discuss your journey and the next steps.

programmes.title: Early Years & Fundamentals
programmes.eyebrow: Small steps. A love of movement.
programmes.intro: Give young children a positive start in sport through play. Our preschool First Kicks sessions combine movement basics, ball skills and fun games to make being active an enjoyable part of their day.
programmes.audience: Preschools, early childhood centres and educators looking to introduce active learning through sport.

features.title: Learn through play
features.text: Fun games and activities introduce movement in an encouraging preschool environment.

features.title: Build the basics
features.text: Children practise fundamental motor skills and ball handling as they explore what they can do.

features.title: A positive first experience
features.text: Our coaches focus on enjoyment, participation and healthy physical activity.

programmes.title: School Sports & Coaching
programmes.intro: Make it easier to give students a great sporting experience. We work with schools to deliver coaching, activities and team support that fit their needs and encourage more young people to get involved.
programmes.audience: Primary and intermediate schools, secondary schools and colleges, PE departments and school sports coordinators.

features.title: Sport within the school day
features.text: Football, futsal and recreational activities help students develop skills, teamwork and confidence.

features.title: Support for school teams
features.text: Coaching support for trials, training and team development, shaped around your school's requirements.

features.title: Make room for everyone
features.text: Have-a-go activities, multi-sport festivals and student leadership opportunities encourage wider participation.

programmes.title: Holiday Programmes
programmes.intro: Active days filled with sport, games and opportunities to learn. Our holiday programmes bring young people together to develop skills, enjoy being active and make connections through sport.
programmes.audience: Families looking for active school holiday options, and clubs or organisations interested in hosting a programme.

features.title: Skills and plenty of play
features.text: Coaching activities, games and challenges make learning part of the fun.

features.title: Teamwork and connection
features.text: A chance to meet others, work together and enjoy a shared sporting experience.

features.title: Local programmes
features.text: We deliver programmes with sports partners. Contact us for upcoming locations, dates and registration information.

programmes.title: Coach Development
programmes.eyebrow: Better support for the people who coach
programmes.intro: Keep learning, share ideas and grow your coaching practice. We create opportunities for coaches to develop through practical experience, workshops and connection with the wider coaching community.
programmes.audience: New and developing coaches, school and club coaches, and organisations looking to support their coaching teams.

features.title: Practical learning
features.text: Hands-on coaching opportunities help developing coaches build experience and confidence.

features.title: Workshops and new perspectives
features.text: Coach development sessions explore ways to create positive experiences and better support young athletes.

features.title: A coaching community
features.text: Connect with other coaches, exchange ideas and keep developing your approach.

faq.question: Which programme is right for us?
faq.answer: Tell us who the programme is for, your sport and what you want to achieve. Our team can discuss the options for an individual player, school, preschool, club or community organisation.

faq.question: Do you offer more than football?
faq.answer: Yes. Proteus works across a range of sports and activities, including basketball. Get in touch with your sport and the type of coaching you need so we can discuss a suitable option.

faq.question: How do I express interest in the 2027 Academy?
faq.answer: Email oliver@proteus.nz for football or isaac@proteus.nz for basketball. Include your name and age, sport, school, and current team or club. The team will be in touch to discuss the next steps.

faq.question: Where can I find holiday dates and registration details?
faq.answer: Contact oliver@proteus.nz for upcoming holiday programmes, locations and registration information. Programme details vary, so check the information for the specific camp before booking.

faq.question: How can our school or club work with Proteus?
faq.answer: Contact patrick@proteus.nz with your organisation, the sport or activity, the group you want to support and your goals. We can discuss coaching and programme options that fit your needs.
